# Inactive new-moon boss movement

Random28 ring 6 offline refinement found a guarded move of the original
Revenge Attack angel duo boss from the middle to lower room. Moon tracking is
inactive; during movement its health changes from 1015 to 1025 before phase
understanding changes from 6 to 5. Version 433 permits only the captured boss,
health after the movement callback, attack, size and phase signature.

Two original and two repaired independent native observations replay all ten
inputs and compare complete states and RNG. Four concurrent branches preserve
their parent, and an unknown boss remains rejected. This is a component
observation, not a battle or campaign victory.

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Check-Models.ps1 -Fixture player-random28-ring6-newmoon-boss-original.mt2f
```
